references.handling: extracted to Markdown in source order; bibliography not atomized

coverage_decision: All nine Appendix A measure specifications, the update-method narrative, the reference section, and the author/reviewer relationship appendices were inspected. The nine formal measures are represented as LiteratureAtoms and in the SEA measure table.
omissions: Individual bibliography entries were not treated as evidence atoms.
Individual author and reviewer disclosure rows were not condensed person by person in the SEA; governance method and relevant-conflict presence are summarized.
Primary-study results cited in the rationale sections were not atomized from this secondary source.
source_integrity_findings: The abstract and Appendix A classify the monoclonal-protein-screen measure as quality measure QM-6, while Top 10 Take-Home Message 10 calls it a performance measure. The atom follows the Appendix A operational specification and carries a source_classification_conflict tag.

Top 10 Take-Home Message 5 says all measures exclude patients after heart transplantation or LVAD placement, but Appendix A lists no such exclusions for QM-2, QM-3, or QM-6. The SEA artifact treats each Appendix A specification as the operational source and preserves this front-matter inconsistency.
